en: A colorized vintage image of a wide, elegant boulevard lined with ornate, historic buildings. The street is bustling with people, horse-drawn carriages, and early trams. There is a person on horseback in the foreground, and the street is flanked by trees. The top of the postcard reads 'Budapest. Andrássy-ut. - Andrássy-Straße. Boulevard Andrássy.' The signage on the buildings and the overall aesthetic suggest an early 20th-century European city.
